XOM.reason: XOM: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp (CIK 0002115436) became successor registrant of Exxon Mobil Corp (CIK 0000034088) common stock under Rule 12g-3(a) on 2026-07-01 (8-K12B, accession 0001193125-26-291990; one-for-one exchange, same directors and officers, same ticker). cik_map.json maps XOM to the successor only, so the feed held 1 print against 118 Item 2.02 8-Ks filed by the predecessor (2005-10-27 to 2026-05-01; 82 dated 2011 or later; no date in common; every predecessor stamp agrees with its own filing header). On 2026-10-01 those 118 were inserted; the held print, every other ticker and cik_map.json are unchanged. No S1-S6 screen result, earnings plan, [earnings] ledger row or earnings brief named XOM; its one successor print is a single row in the pooled run-up study output (reports/preprint_runup_study_2026-09-30.json), which is not restated. The 8-K12B cover cites the predecessor's Commission File Number 001-02256; EDGAR indexes the successor's own filings, including the 2026-07-31 print, under 001-43384.
XOM.verified: 2026-09-30 against SEC's submissions JSON, SEC's company_tickers.json and the 8-K12B itself; the 118 predecessor stamps were checked against their filing headers

_verified_not_adopted.why: The same scan found these four. They are verified and deliberately NOT adopted. Each needs its own gate before it can be adopted: (1) a Rule 12g-3 successor of the same issuer, one-for-one, same ticker; (2) a continuous price column across the succession date; (3) the full page-rule output, no cut chosen by anyone; (4) a collision never rewrites a held print; (5) no S1-S6 verdict, plan, ledger row or forecast already seen on the name's short history; (6) the same insert-only mechanism, with its own record, commit and check. XOM went first because it was blocked at S1 (1 print), its next print is on the clock (about 2026-10-30) and no verdict had been seen on it. GOOG, AVGO and MRVL already sit above the S1 floor, so adopting them would change S2-S6 values rather than unblock anything, and the agent must never union predecessor prints for any name in its own scratch code: that would be the same correction done silently and unevenly.

GOOG.evidence: 8-K12B 2015-10-02, accession 0001193125-15-336577: Alphabet Inc. became the successor issuer to Google Inc. in a holding company reorganization

AVGO.evidence: 8-K12B 2018-04-04, accession 0001193125-18-107559: Broadcom Inc. (Delaware) is the successor issuer to Broadcom Limited (Singapore); the Avago to Broadcom Limited link needs its own 8-K12B evidence

MRVL.evidence: 8-K12B 2021-04-20, accession 0001193125-21-122938: Marvell Technology, Inc. is the successor issuer to Marvell Technology Group and to Inphi under Rule 12g-3(c), so the Inphi merger is part of the same transaction and needs its own gate (2)

LIN.evidence: 8-K12B 2018-11-02: Linde plc succeeded Praxair in a merger of equals and the ticker changed from PX to LIN. A definition question, not a correction: not proposed.
